title: Service Level Conditions Governing the Late Resumption Loading on Workplace Cafe Management Program Contracts
content:
Notice of a resumption is measured on a Workplace Cafe Management Program contract as the calendar days between the day an approved resumption request was logged and the day it asked service to return, and that measure, with the suspension requests standing approved on the contract, settles the late resumption loading.

**Condition 1.** Where the calendar days between the day an approved resumption request was logged and the day it asked service to return fall short of the resumption notice printed against the service model and two or more suspension requests stand approved on the contract, the late resumption loading is the repeated short resumption loading, which is 20 per cent.

**Condition 2.** Where the calendar days between the day an approved resumption request was logged and the day it asked service to return fall short of the resumption notice printed against the service model and fewer than two suspension requests stand approved on the contract, the late resumption loading is the single short resumption loading, which is 10 per cent.

**Condition 3.** Where the calendar days between the day an approved resumption request was logged and the day it asked service to return reach the resumption notice printed against the service model, the late resumption loading is the nil late resumption loading: no late resumption loading is taken.

| Notice on the resumption | Suspension requests standing approved | Late resumption loading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Falls short of the resumption notice printed against the service model | Two or more | The repeated short resumption loading, 20 per cent |
| Falls short of the resumption notice printed against the service model | Fewer than two | The single short resumption loading, 10 per cent |
| Reaches the resumption notice printed against the service model | Whatever they number | The nil late resumption loading, no loading taken |

**Condition 4.** The day an approved resumption request was logged, the day it asked service to return and the suspension requests standing approved are read from the contract's service request log; the resumption notice is the figure printed against the service model the contract is held in.

**Condition 5.** On hypothetical days, against a hypothetical resumption notice printed against the service model of 7 calendar days: a request logged on 2026-05-02 asking service to return on 2026-05-06 gives 4 calendar days, falling short of 7, so with two approved suspension requests standing the loading is 20 per cent and with one standing it is 10 per cent. The same request asking service to return on 2026-05-09 gives 7 calendar days, which reach 7, and no loading is taken.
